column9: This page, and the community files every repository inherits: conduct, support, security, accessibility.
The source of aboutcorwin.com: who Corwin is, what he keeps and where to find him.
Signed method tools lifted from a security engagement, verifiable against pinned keys; cases never travel.
One binary boots disk images and runs container images on Windows and Linux, with a CLI and a web dashboard.
Cron that never skips leg day: one table on GNU/Linux and Windows, missed runs made up, every run logged.
The shop's front door: draw as home page, a directory of our repositories, curated packages.
Drive an Elgato Stream Deck from any program by writing plain lines to it; no vendor software at all.
Draws how your machines and repositories connect, from the file each keeps; runs in your browser.
One set of design tokens rooted in GNU Emacs's Modus themes, carried to CSS, Org HTML, Emacs themes and more.
Four-player drop-in co-op A Link to the Past as a native PC game, on one PC, LAN or internet, from your ROM.
An Android emulator for desktop gaming: key and mouse maps for touch games, controllers, per-game profiles.
Gated agent-skill synthesis: notes' tags pass a gate, skill skeletons are minted, and bundles come out.
The stage behind ghostlights.theater: shows made from writing, where every claim names its witness.
A self-hosted forge for people and agents, packaged for Debian, with a medic that mends and an Omni door.
Pick a word and move a four-way slider: simpler, denser, moodier, drier; every sentence says who wrote it.
Signed essays from the open shelf, starting with two accounts of the 2026 GNU Savannah forensic review.
Community time banking for Nextcloud: post requests, volunteer, earn hours, every movement in a public ledger.
OBS Studio as a readable configuration: every setting an atom you can diff, credentials held back.
One person's OBS rig on obsmage: profiles, scenes and screen maps as atoms, with open questions.
Literate distributed file systems, striped across hosts and kept as Org files a person can read.
A copy of the publication shelf: papers, posts, persona sheets, the canon and the books, refreshed by script.
A 3D particle, atom and molecule simulator for learning chemistry and physics in the browser, offline.
Builds patched end-of-life PHP for SuiteCRM from the project's own mitigation commits, and proves it installs.
A portable operating-model kit: one file dropped into a session so an AI grounds itself in its host's canon.
Recorded talk in three layers, each citing the one below: quotes by time, subjects, then a result with seams.
A memory Claude keeps on your own computer in plain files, with the skills, persona sheets and shared rooms.
Written ways of working that Claude reads when a task calls for them; each skill is also a slash command.
